We are looking for a skilled Data Analyst to join our team on a remote basis, supporting a major project in Riyadh. The ideal candidate will have proven experience in data analysis, business intelligence, and transforming data into actionable insights to support decision-making and operational performance.

Analyze large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and insights
Develop dashboards and reports using BI tools (e.g., Power BI)
Perform data cleaning, validation, and data quality checks
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements
Support data-driven decision-making through clear reporting and visualization

Automate reporting processes where applicable

About the Job

IT Data Analyst

Jeddah, Saudi Arabia

The Opportunity

TSC is partnering with a leading organization to identify an experienced IT Data Analyst to join its Information Technology team in Jeddah.

Reporting to the BI & Analytics Director, the IT Data Analyst will play a key role in transforming data into actionable business insights, developing advanced Power BI dashboards and reports, supporting data-driven decision-making, and contributing to AI-enabled analytics initiatives.

This is an excellent opportunity for a data analytics professional with strong Power BI and SQL expertise, hands-on experience in business intelligence and data visualization, and exposure to Microsoft Fabric and AI-powered analytics.

Key Responsibilities
• Partner with business stakeholders to understand data requirements and translate business questions into analytical solutions.
• Analyze complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and opportunities for business improvement.
• Collect, prepare, validate, and analyze data from multiple internal and external sources.
• Develop and maintain interactive Power BI dashboards and reports across functions including Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain, Sales, and other business areas.
• Develop datasets, measures, dataflows, and data models to support reporting and analytics requirements.
• Apply DAX and Power Query (M) for data transformation and analytical calculations.
• Monitor data quality, consistency, and accuracy and support data governance initiatives.
• Collaborate with BI, data engineering, and IT teams to ensure data availability, integrity, and reporting performance.
• Standardize visuals, KPIs, and data definitions across Power BI reporting.
• Support self-service BI and enable business users to leverage standardized datasets.
• Troubleshoot data and reporting issues and identify opportunities for performance optimization.
• Document data sources, analytical methodologies, report specifications, and BI assets.
• Provide analytical support for ad-hoc business requirements and strategic BI initiatives.
• Leverage Microsoft Fabric and Power BI AI capabilities, including Copilot and natural-language querying, to enhance data exploration, reporting, and productivity.
• Validate AI-generated insights and outputs to ensure accuracy, business relevance, and alignment with approved KPIs.
• Identify opportunities to automate repetitive reporting and analytical activities.

Requirements
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related field.
• 3–7 years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or a related IT field.
• Minimum 3–5 years of hands-on experience with SQL, Power BI, data visualization, and BI reporting.
• Advanced proficiency in Power BI, including dashboards, datasets, dataflows, measures, and report development.
• Strong knowledge of DAX and Power Query (M).
• Proficiency in SQL and experience working with relational databases and data warehouses.
• Experience with data modeling and data preparation techniques.
• Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric, including Data Warehouse, Lakehouse, OneLake, and Data Pipelines, and their integration with Power BI.
• Exposure to AI-assisted analytics, Power BI Copilot, natural-language querying, or reporting automation.
• Familiarity with Python or R for data analysis and modeling is an advantage.
• Experience with Tableau or Looker is a plus.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Certifications
• Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300)
• Microsoft Certified: Data Analyst Associate
• Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate (DP-600) is a plus.

We are seeking an experienced Business Analyst

To bridge the gap between business stakeholders and technical teams in the implementation of a telecom data lakehouse/data warehouse. The Business Analyst will gather business requirements, analyze telecom processes and data, define business rules, and translate business needs into detailed functional specifications, ensuring successful delivery of data products, reports, and analytics solutions.

Key responsibilities

• Gather and analyze business requirements from stakeholders across telecom domains such as customer, billing, CRM, network, revenue assurance, finance, sales, marketing, and digital channels.

• Conduct workshops and interviews with business users to understand reporting, analytical, and operational requirements.

• Document business processes, functional requirements, and business rules.

• Capture business requirements into functional specifications for data engineers, data modelers, ETL developers, and BI developers.

• Define source-to-target mapping requirements and validate data transformations.

• Collaborate with solution architects and data modelers to ensure business requirements are accurately reflected in the data lakehouse/data warehouse design.

• Identify data sources, business definitions, KPIs, dimensions, and measures required for reporting and analytics.

• Support the definition of data quality rules, validation criteria, and reconciliation requirements.

• Review ETL mapping documents and ensure business logic is correctly implemented.

• Work closely with data engineers during development to clarify business rules and resolve functional issues.

• Participate in user acceptance testing (UAT) by preparing test scenarios, validating results, and obtaining business sign-off.

• Maintain business glossaries, metadata, and documentation.

• Facilitate communication between business stakeholders and technical teams throughout the project lifecycle.

• Support Agile ceremonies including backlog refinement, sprint planning, and requirement prioritization.

Requirements

• Strong business analysis and requirement elicitation skills.

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.

• Experience documenting business requirements and functional specifications.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Understanding of relational databases and SQL.

• Basic knowledge of data warehousing concepts such as:

• Facts and dimensions

• Star schema

• Snowflake schema

• Slowly changing dimensions (SCD)

• Data lineage

• Metadata management

• Data quality

• Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

Preferred technical knowledge

• SQL

• Data warehouse / data lakehouse architecture

• ETL concepts and data integration

• Data mapping documentation

• Data quality frameworks

• BI and reporting platforms

• Knowledge of Hadoop ecosystem, Hive, Impala, Spark, or cloud data platforms is an advantage.

Deliverables

• Business requirement documents (BRD)

• Functional requirement specifications (FRS)

• KPI definitions

• Data dictionary

• Business glossary

• Data validation and UAT test cases

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in information technology, computer science, business information systems, engineering, or a related field.

• 2-4 years of experience as a Business Analyst in data warehouse, data lakehouse, or business intelligence projects.

• Experience in the telecommunications industry is highly preferred.

• Ensures the mechanism for implementing data collection activities and building data warehouses to conduct the necessary analyses.
• Provides support for activities related to providing a historical and current view of operations, using the data available in the data warehouse in addition to operational data.

HR Data Analyst - Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

About Saudi Gold Refinery

Saudi Gold Refinery (SGR) is a Saudi mining and precious-metals company specialized in the refining of gold and precious metals, bullion production, and value-added precious-metal services. Operating within the Kingdom’s mining value chain, SGR is aligned to the Vision 2030 mining pillar and to the regulatory framework set by the Ministry of Industry and Mineral Resources (MIM) and applicable Saudi and international standards. We produce responsibly sourced, traceable, and certified bullion, operate to LBMA Good Delivery and ISO-aligned quality standards, and invest in the people, processes, and controls behind every bar we produce.
Role Overview

Saudi Gold Refinery (SGR) is seeking a HR Data Analyst in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia to manage workforce data integrity and generate strategic insights for our refining and corporate operations. This role ensures accurate reporting for Saudization, GOSI, and MHRSD compliance while supporting data-driven decision-making. The analyst will maintain HRIS accuracy and develop dashboards that track key metrics such as turnover, absenteeism, and labor costs.

The HR Data Analyst will report directly to the VP of HR and will play a key role in transforming raw personnel data into actionable intelligence. This position supports the optimization of workforce planning and ensures regulatory compliance across all SGR facilities.

Key Responsibilities The HR Data Analyst will execute the following responsibilities to ensure data accuracy and strategic insight.

Data Integrity Management The role maintains the accuracy of employee master data in the HRIS by conducting weekly audits and correcting discrepancies in job titles, cost centers, and reporting lines.

Regulatory Compliance Reporting

This position prepares and submits monthly Nitaqat and GOSI reports to ensure SGR meets all Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development requirements.

Dashboard Development The analyst designs and updates Power BI dashboards that visualize workforce trends including turnover rates, time-to-fill, and overtime expenditures.

Workforce Analytics The role analyzes shift coverage and absenteeism data to identify operational risks and support workforce planning for plant and laboratory staff.

System Administration

This position administers user access and permissions within the HRIS to ensure data security and proper role-based visibility for HR staff.

Audit Support The analyst provides verified workforce data and documentation trails to support internal audits and external regulatory inspections.

Process Automation

This role identifies manual reporting tasks and develops SQL queries or Excel macros to automate data extraction and reduce processing time.

Stakeholder Collaboration The analyst collaborates with Finance and IT to reconcile headcount costs and resolve integration issues between HRIS and payroll systems.

Qualifications

● Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Statistics, Data Science, or a related quantitative field.

● Minimum of three years of experience in HR analytics or workforce planning within an industrial or manufacturing environment.

● Proficiency in SQL and advanced Excel functions including pivot tables, VLOOKUP, and macro automation.

● Demonstrated experience with HRIS platforms such as SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM, or Workday.

● In-depth knowledge of Saudi labor laws, GOSI regulations, and MHRSD digital platforms including Qiwa and Mudad.

● Ability to translate complex data sets into clear, actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders.

● Strong understanding of Saudization tiers and the impact of Nitaqat ratings on operational licensing.

● Fluency in English is required for reporting and system navigation, with Arabic proficiency preferred for local regulatory interaction.

Preferred / Nice-to-have

● Experience in the mining, refining, or heavy industry sector with exposure to shift-based workforce structures.

● Certification in Human Resources Analytics or People Analytics from a recognized professional body.

● Prior experience supporting LBMA or ISO audits with workforce documentation and traceability records.

● Knowledge of Power Query and DAX for advanced data modeling and transformation.

● Familiarity with visa and residency management processes via Muqeem and Absher platforms.

Success Metrics

● 100% accuracy in monthly GOSI and MHRSD submissions with zero regulatory penalties.

● 40% reduction in manual reporting time through the automation of key HR dashboards.

● Establishment of a single source of truth for workforce data that aligns HR, Finance, and Operations records.

● Delivery of a predictive turnover model that identifies flight risks in critical technical roles.

● Achievement of the target Nitaqat tier through precise Saudization tracking and reporting.

● Completion of a full audit of employee master data with a cleanliness rate of 98% or higher.

● Successful integration of HRIS data with Finance systems for accurate monthly headcount reconciliation.

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Saudi Gold Refinery welcomes applications from all qualified candidates. Hiring decisions are made based on role requirements, skills, experience, and alignment with Saudization and Vision 2030 priorities.
